summary: Scans the race standings linked list (dword_7D2DB0) for the entries whose field at offset 412 equals 1 (position 1) and 2 (position 2), fast-pathing the first entry when it already holds the sought value. For each position, detects whether any other active entry shares the same field value at offset 408 (interpreted as a tie) and suppresses dispatch on that position when tied. When the a1 dispatch flag is set and the position is uniquely held, it resolves the entrant display strings (name at entry offset 0, secondary string at offset 8, both falling back to byte_5EA438), looks the name up in the format list dword_5EA5E8 via NamedEntryLookupInFormatList, and emits message 397 through DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion with position parameter 2 for position 1 or 3 for position 2, inserting the populated entry with InsertDriverTableEntry(flt_5EA618, ...). Returns a1 when the dispatch flag is set, otherwise the tie flags, or the StructInitWithSentinelValues result when both positions exist with no tie.

local_names.v36: tie flag for position 1 (set when another entry shares the offset-408 value)
local_names.v37: tie flag for position 2 (set when another entry shares the offset-408 value)
local_names.v6: scan loop index for the position-1 entry
local_names.v12: tie-scan loop index for the position-1 entry
local_names.v22: scan loop index for the position-2 entry
local_names.v28: tie-scan loop index for the position-2 entry
local_names.v39: driver table entry buffer (BYREF) initialized then populated
local_names.v5: located position-1 entry pointer, aliasing v2
local_names.v21: located position-2 entry pointer, aliasing v1

operations.description: Initialize locals v1=0, v2=0, v36=0 and v37=0 before the position scans
Dereference the standings list wrapper dword_7D2DB0 with LinkedListDereference and obtain the first/base standings entry with FixedOffsetReturn
If the first entry's field at offset 412 equals 1, treat it as the position-1 entry without scanning

Otherwise scan indices 0..ActiveEntityCounter-1, calling ShortComputation_13a0(i) to test each entry's offset-412 value for 1; break on the first match and keep its pointer; if no entry matches, skip the position-1 dispatch path
Store the located position-1 entry pointer into v2
When the position-1 entry is not the first entry and shares the offset-408 value with the first entry, set the position-1 tie flag v36
Scan every other active entry via ShortComputation_13a0; whenever one shares the position-1 entry's offset-408 value, set the tie flag v36
Dispatch position 1 only when the tie flag v36 is clear and the dispatch flag a1 is set
Initialize the driver table entry buffer v39 with StructInitWithSentinelValues
Resolve display strings for the position-1 entry: secondary string at offset 8 (v16) and name at offset 0 (v17); a null/zero value falls back to &byte_5EA438
Resolve the display name/id from the format list dword_5EA5E8 with NamedEntryLookupInFormatList(name, secondary)
Populate the driver table entry v39 via DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion with message id 397, the resolved lookup result, position parameter 2 and sentinel values -1/-1/-2.0/-2.0
Insert the populated driver table entry into the shared table with InsertDriverTableEntry(flt_5EA618, v39)

For position 2, first entry's offset-412 value equal to 2 fast-paths it; otherwise scan indices 0..ActiveEntityCounter-1 via ShortComputation_13a0 for an entry with offset-412 value 2, skipping the position-2 path if none is found
Store the located position-2 entry pointer into v1
Detect ties for position 2: if the entry is not the first entry and shares the offset-408 value with it, or any other active entry shares its offset-408 value, set the tie flag v37
When the position-2 tie flag v37 is set, skip the position-2 dispatch path

When a1 is set, mirror the position-1 dispatch for position 2: initialize v39 with StructInitWithSentinelValues, fall back null name/offset-8 strings to &byte_5EA438, resolve via NamedEntryLookupInFormatList from dword_5EA5E8, populate via DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion with message id 397 and position parameter 3, then InsertDriverTableEntry(flt_5EA618, v39)
When the dispatch flag a1 is set, return a1 immediately
Otherwise return the tie flags: v36, then v37 if v36 is clear; when both positions exist and neither tie flag is set, return the StructInitWithSentinelValues(v39) result
Called by SeasonDisplayIDResolver (0x0041DAF0), which drives standings display in season context
